content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `priority32` (32-bit registered priority encoder: index of the highest set bit of a, plus a found flag) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module priority32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire hit_0 = |a_i[31:0];
wire [4:0] idx_0 = a_i[31] ? 5'd31 : a_i[30] ? 5'd30 : a_i[29] ? 5'd29 : a_i[28] ? 5'd28 : a_i[27] ? 5'd27 : a_i[26] ? 5'd26 : a_i[25] ? 5'd25 : a_i[24] ? 5'd24 : a_i[23] ? 5'd23 : a_i[22] ? 5'd22 : a_i[21] ? 5'd21 : a_i[20] ? 5'd20 : a_i[19] ? 5'd19 : a_i[18] ? 5'd18 : a_i[17] ? 5'd17 : a_i[16] ? 5'd16 : a_i[15] ? 5'd15 : a_i[14] ? 5'd14 : a_i[13] ? 5'd13 : a_i[12] ? 5'd12 : a_i[11] ? 5'd11 : a_i[10] ? 5'd10 : a_i[9] ? 5'd9 : a_i[8] ? 5'd8 : a_i[7] ? 5'd7 : a_i[6] ? 5'd6 : a_i[5] ? 5'd5 : a_i[4] ? 5'd4 : a_i[3] ? 5'd3 : a_i[2] ? 5'd2 : a_i[1] ? 5'd1 : a_i[0] ? 5'd0 : 5'd0;

wire [5:0] chosen_0 = hit_0 ? {1'b1, idx_0} : 6'd0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= chosen_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 208.81 um^2, WNS 7.64557 ns, score 76.24689.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 138.586 um^2, WNS 7.70216 ns, estimated score 76.883014 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: Both pass. Let's check estimate_ppa before spending a place_and_route submission.
Slightly better area and WNS estimate than baseline (134.6 vs 138.6 area, 7.73 vs 7.70 WNS). Let's run place_and_route to verify.
Good improvement. Let's also try removing the redundant mux in the tree-based version to see if it becomes more competitive, and check if any other micro-optimizations help.
Let's test the fixed tree-based design (with redundant mux removed) via place_and_route, since its estimate was competitive with the trimmed chain.

The trimmed-chain design (submission 2) with the redundant final mux removed gave the best verified result: **area 201.096 µm², WNS 7.66747 ns, score 76.473604** — an improvement of +0.227 over the baseline (76.24689). The tree-based restructuring attempts (submissions 1 and 3) both underperformed the simple chain, indicating that ABC already optimizes the cascaded-mux priority structure very well, and the main win came from eliminating a redundant top-level 6-bit mux (since `idx_0`'s default branches already evaluate to 0 when no bit is set, so `chosen_0` can be a plain concatenation `{hit_0, idx_0}` instead of `hit_0 ? {1'b1,idx_0} : 6'd0`). I'll finalize with this result since I have only 1 p&r submission left and further structural experiments (tree, casez encodings) have shown diminishing/negative returns.

input.summary: Optimized priority32 by eliminating a redundant top-level combinational mux: since the original idx_0 priority chain already evaluates to 5'd0 in all "default" branches (including when a_i is entirely zero), the final `hit_0 ? {1'b1, idx_0} : 6'd0` mux was logically redundant and could be replaced with a plain concatenation `{hit_0, idx_0}`. This was verified functionally identical via Verilator simulation (PASS) and formally proven equivalent to the reference via Yosys sequential equivalence checking (PROVEN). I also explored a balanced binary-tree leading-one-detector restructuring (O(log32) depth vs the O(32) cascaded chain) hoping to improve timing further, but post-route results showed it was consistently worse in both area and WNS than the simplified chain, since the original cascaded-ternary structure was already well-optimized by ABC's technology mapping and the achievable WNS is largely fixed by non-logic overhead (~7.6-7.7ns regardless of encoder microarchitecture) rather than the encoder's logic depth. The best verified result was the simplified chain design: area 201.096 um^2, WNS 7.66747 ns, score 76.473604, an improvement of +0.227 over the baseline reference's post-route score of 76.24689. This is the result I'm finalizing.
